description: Defines the em_cli_t class for command line interface operations, including command retrieval, execution, configuration, and debugging functions, along with a function to get the CLI instance.

classes.name: em_cli_t
classes.description: Class providing command line interface functionalities such as command retrieval, execution, configuration, and debugging.

methods.name: get_command
methods.description: Retrieves the command based on input parameters, optionally refining with a network node.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a command on a specified network node.

methods.name: set_remote_addr
methods.description: Initializes remote address configuration with IP, port, and validity.

methods.name: is_remote_addr_valid
methods.description: Checks if the remote address is valid.

methods.name: get_next_cmd_str
methods.description: Retrieves the next command string based on input.

methods.name: get_reset_tree
methods.description: Gets the reset tree for a specified platform.

methods.name: init_lib_dbg
methods.description: Initializes debugging environment with a log file.

methods.name: dump_lib_dbg
methods.description: Dumps debug information to the log.
